cells.gaps: No source found names a route that avoids Cameroon or its one landing station at Kribi. Chad's March 2026 submission to ITU-D and the minister in October 2026 speak of one link or one access via Cameroon (TCD-003, TCD-002); Southwood in November 2026, the newer, gives two routes through Cameroon to Kribi (TCD-009).
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-12: Southwood (November 2026) says Chad has two fibre routes through Cameroon to the Kribi landing station (TCD-009), as Tchadinfos named in May 2025 (TCD-007), so two routes that share one neighbour and one landing station: stage 3.
